scripts.text: You have too many kinds of objects. Let's try to continue after reducing those objects.
scripts.translation: 您的物品種類太多了。請先減少物品種類，然後再繼續。

scripts.text: Can't continue because you have too many heavy objects. Let's try to continue after reducing the weight.
scripts.translation: 由於您攜帶了太多重物，無法繼續。請先減輕負重，然後再繼續。

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
Wow welcome. It is new Mayomayo refinement store~ I enchant some luxury weapons including level 4 weapons.
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
哇，歡迎光臨。這是全新的馬約馬約強化商店~ 我可以強化一些高階武器，包括+4的武器。

scripts.text: Any store policy changes?
scripts.translation: 商店政策有變化嗎？

scripts.text: Enchant High Ranked Weapon
scripts.translation: 強化高階武器

scripts.text: Initialize Enchant (Need Silvervine Fruit)
scripts.translation: 重置強化（需要獼猴桃果實）

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
When I enchant weapons, the slotted cards or refined level are dissipated sometimes. I hated it. However, one day I found how to do it without any extinction.
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
以前我強化武器時，鑲嵌的卡片或強化等級有時會消失。我很討厭那樣。不過有一天，我找到了不會導致任何損失的方法。

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
Have you ever seen a building of person of reinforcement capacity association?
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
你見過強化能力協會的建築嗎？

scripts.text: I've seen it before.
scripts.translation: 我見過。

scripts.text: I haven't seen it before.
scripts.translation: 我沒見過。

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
That builiding is located to the southeast of where I am. Why don't you go on a field trip there?
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
那棟建築位於我所在位置的東南方。你要不要去那裡實地考察一下？

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
If you go to the place, there is someone who enchants the Archangel Wing. At that time that was amazing, because that was impossible ability by my own skill.
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
如果你去那裡，會看到有人能強化天使之翼。當時那真的很驚人，因為以我自己的技術，那是絕對做不到的。

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
Every night I became his butler and did odd jobs. That is how I learned to enchant.
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
每天晚上我都做他的管家，幹些雜活。我就是那樣學會強化的。

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
Several rules are changed. Well, you better have experience.
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
有幾條規則變了。嗯，你最好有點經驗。

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
Did you take off your equipment?
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
你脫掉裝備了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
This is not a suitable equipment for the enchant. Don't forget we only take care of high class weapons, including level 4 weapons~
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
這件裝備不適合強化。別忘了，我們只處理高階武器，包括+4的武器~

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
This equipment can not be initialized. Don't forget we only handle some luxury weapons, including level 4 weapons~
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
這件裝備無法重置。別忘了，我們只處理一些高階武器，包括+4的武器~

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
^0000ff{0}^000000! Do you want to enchant this equipment? How will you pay for this?
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
^0000ff{0}^000000！你想強化這件裝備嗎？你打算怎麼支付費用？

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
Come back again if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
如果你改變主意，歡迎隨時再來。

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
You don't have enough coins. Do you want to check again?
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
你的金幣不足。你要再檢查一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
When you use the {0}, you can choose the enchant type.
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
使用{0}時，你可以選擇強化型別。

scripts.text: Stop
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text: Short Range Type
scripts.translation: 短程型

scripts.text: Long Range Type
scripts.translation: 遠端型

scripts.text: Caster Type
scripts.translation: 施法型

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
Ok. If you change your mind, let me know.
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
好的。如果你改變主意，請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
This equipment is at the end of enchant. Please initialize the enchant and you will be able to enchant it again, or bring another weapon.
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
這件裝備的強化等級已達上限。請重置強化，或者換一件武器再來。

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
I'm trying for the {0} enchant. ^ff0000It will not touch previous refinement and cards. Also, the equipment will not be destroyed.^000000 Can I continue?
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
我將進行{0}強化。^ff0000這不會影響之前的精煉等級和卡片，裝備也不會損壞。^000000可以開始嗎？

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來。

scripts.text: Please, continue.
scripts.translation: 請繼續。

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
Ok. If you change your mind, come back again.
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
好的。如果你改變主意，歡迎隨時再來。

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
There is something wrong. Please try again.
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
出了點問題。請再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
This equipment is at the end of enchant. I provide enchant for two times maximum.
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
這件裝備的強化等級已達上限。我最多隻能強化兩次。

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
Surely I don't enchant at card socket, therefore weapons that have 3 slots can be enchanted only 1 time. Don't forget this~
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
我肯定不在卡槽上進行強化，所以有3個卡槽的武器只能強化1次。別忘了哦~

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
Oh my god!
This equipment is destroyed because it could not endure powerful ability. I'm so sorry.
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
天哪！
這件裝備因為無法承受強大的力量而損壞了。非常抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
I have enchanted ^990000slot {0}^000000 of this equipment.
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
我已經強化了這件裝備的^990000第{0}個卡槽^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
I will only initialize the enchant effect without touching previous refined level and cards.
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
我只會重置強化效果，不會影響之前的精煉等級和卡片。

scripts.text: Stop
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text: Continue
scripts.translation: 繼續

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
If you change your mind, come back anytime.
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
如果你改變主意，歡迎隨時再來。

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
I'm sorry. You don't have Silvervine Fruit. Please check your inventory again?
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
抱歉。你沒有獼猴桃果實。請再檢查一下你的物品欄？

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
Did you take off the equipment?
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
你把裝備取下來了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
This equipment has nothing to initialize. Please check again.
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
這件裝備沒有需要重置的強化效果。請再檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Mayomayo]
Initialize the enchant effect from the equipment.
scripts.translation:
[馬約馬約]
重置這件裝備的強化效果。
